channel.title: InYourBones Daily Music News
channel.description: Top 5 daily music stories handpicked by InYourBones

item.title: HYUKOH Announce New Album, 33, First US Tour Dates Since 2019
item.description: HYUKOH are back on the road in the U.S. with their first tour dates since 2019—and a new album, *33*, on the way 🎸✨

item.title: Latin Grammys Add Karol G, Bizarrap, Nathy Peluso, Bad Gyal & More to 2026 Performer Lineup
item.description: Karol G, Bizarrap, Nathy Peluso, Bad Gyal and more are bringing the heat to the 2026 Latin Grammys lineup 🔥🎶

item.title: Rush Announce Sphere Residency
item.description: Rush are taking their legendary sound to the Sphere! 🎸 Vegas is about to get a whole lot louder. 🤘

item.title: 2026 CMA Awards Announce Kacey Musgraves, Ella Langley, Tim McGraw & More Performers, Plus Dolly Parton Tribute
item.description: Country’s biggest night is shaping up to be a star-studded one 🤠 Kacey Musgraves, Ella Langley, Tim McGraw and more hit the CMA stage, with a Dolly Parton tribute, too!

item.title: Bon Jovi Confirm New 2027 Stadium Shows, Including at Notre Dame Stadium
item.description: Bon Jovi are heading back to the stadiums in 2027—including Notre Dame! 🎸🏟️ Who’s ready to sing along?
